title: Service-to-repo identity map (service-map.json)
description: Overrides for component service identity. Default is identity (serviceId = inventory name; owning repo = the repo scanned from, or null). Only overrides are listed.

services.description: Keyed by the inventory service name. Each value overrides that service's owning repo.

repo.description: Owning repo folder (e.g. a monorepo that ships this service), or null for a genuinely repo-less service.
